claim.en: Developers need long uninterrupted blocks to be productive.
claim.zh: 开发者需要长时间不被打断的整块时间才能高效工作。

grade_why.en: Consistent self-reports plus one small randomized trial with self-rated outcomes; no study ties block length to measured output.
grade_why.zh: 自评数据一致，另有一项以自评为结果的小型随机试验；没有研究把时间块长度与实测产出联系起来。

evidence.en: Meyer et al. (2014) surveyed 379 professional developers and observed 11. Developers called a day productive when they finished many or big tasks without significant interruptions or context switches, yet the observed developers switched tasks often and still felt productive. A log study of 86 programmers (Parnin and Rugaber 2011) found only 10% of sessions resumed coding within a minute of an interruption. In a randomized trial of 89 developers (Das Swain et al. 2023), two protected hours a day raised self-rated performance and focus, but not measured coding time.
evidence.zh: Meyer 等人（2014）调查了 379 名专业开发者，并观察了 11 名。开发者认为，完成了很多或很大的任务、且没有明显打断或上下文切换的一天是高效的；但被观察的开发者实际上频繁切换任务，仍觉得自己高效。Parnin 和 Rugaber（2011）对 86 名程序员的日志研究发现，只有 10% 的会话在被打断后 1 分钟内恢复编码。Das Swain 等人（2023）对 89 名开发者的随机试验显示，每天 2 小时的受保护时间提高了自评绩效和专注度，但没有提高实测的编码时间。

caveats.en: Productivity here is self-rated, and the trial's performance and focus effects were significant only at the 10% level. No study tests how long a block must be, so the half-day idea comes from essays such as Paul Graham's maker's schedule. A 2008 lab experiment found interrupted work was finished faster, at the cost of more stress.
caveats.zh: 这里的生产力是自评的，试验中绩效和专注度的效应仅在 10% 水平上显著。没有研究检验时间块需要多长，“半天”之类的说法来自 Paul Graham 的“创造者日程”等文章。2008 年的实验室实验发现，被打断的工作完成得更快，但压力更大。

boss_line.en: Developers say their best days have few interruptions, and a small trial of protected focus time raised self-rated performance. Nobody has shown how long a block must be, so let's protect a couple of hours a day and measure whether it helps.
boss_line.zh: 开发者说自己最高效的日子被打断很少，一项小型试验也显示受保护的专注时间提高了自评绩效。还没有人证明时间块要多长，所以我们先每天保护一两个小时，再看是否有效。

change_my_mind.en: A trial that varies block length and measures output or defects, such as merged changes or cycle time, and shows no loss with fragmented days.
change_my_mind.zh: 有试验改变时间块的长度，并测量产出或缺陷（如合并的变更数或交付周期），结果显示碎片化的工作日并不会造成损失。
